name: Chic walking octave bass
desc: Bernard Edwards school walking bass in Ab major: rolling 8ths over Ab-Fm7-Db-Eb with chromatic approach notes into every chord change and octave pushes. Fat filtered saw with shape drive, sidechain-feel pump on full and peak.

pump.doc: pump floor as fraction of gain

code.sparse: note("<[ab1@2 ab1 g1] [f1@2 f1 e1] [db1@2 db1 c1] [eb1@2 eb1 d1]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.55, ${cut}).slow(32)).lpq(2).attack(.01).decay(.4).sustain(.35).release(.12).shape(.3).gain(${gain}*.78).room(.12).orbit(3).play()
code.full: note("<[ab1 ab1 ab2 ab1 ab1 ab2 g1 ab1] [f1 f1 f2 f1 f1 f2 e1 f1] [db1 db1 db2 db1 db1 db2 c1 db1] [eb1 eb1 eb2 eb1 bb1 eb2 d1 eb1]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype("24db").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.65, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).lpq(4).attack(.005).decay(.18).sustain(.16).release(.05).shape(.35).gain(saw.range(${gain}*${pump}, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[ab1 ab2 ab1 ab2 ab1 ab2 [g1 ab1] [ab1 ab2]] [f1 f2 f1 f2 f1 f2 [e1 f1] [f1 f2]] [db1 db2 db1 db2 db1 db2 [c1 db1] [db1 db2]] [eb1 eb2 eb1 eb2 bb1 eb2 [d1 eb1] [eb2 bb2]]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype("24db").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.9, ${cut}*1.9).slow(8)).lpq(5).attack(.004).decay(.15).sustain(.12).release(.04).shape(.4).gain(saw.range(${gain}*${pump}, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.1).every(8, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(3).play()
